name: @pipeworx/mcp-coresignal

tools.name: coresignal_company
tools.description: Look up a company's firmographics + headcount (size, employee count, industry, founding year, HQ, LinkedIn URL) from Coresignal by company name or website. LinkedIn-adjacent B2B data. Example: coresignal_company({ name: "Stripe", _apiKey: "your-key" })

name.description: Company name to look up, e.g. "Stripe", "OpenAI". Provide this OR `website`.

website.description: Company website/domain, e.g. "stripe.com". Provide this OR `name`.

_apiKey.description: Coresignal API key (BYO). Sign up + start a trial at coresignal.com.

tools.name: coresignal_employee
tools.description: Find a person's professional profile by name (+company) via Coresignal — returns title, current company, location, LinkedIn URL, work experience and education. LinkedIn-adjacent people data. Example: coresignal_employee({ name: "Patrick Collison", company: "Stripe", _apiKey: "your-key" })

name.description: Full name of the person, e.g. "Patrick Collison".

company.description: Optional company name to disambiguate, e.g. "Stripe".

_apiKey.description: Coresignal API key (BYO). Sign up + start a trial at coresignal.com.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-coresignal forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the coresignal pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
